preparation.exact_source_row_equality_semantics: Every retained row equals its original producer row by exact identity and selected schema. This is a deterministic approved subset of the original quarter candidates; it is not whole-source cardinality equality.
limitations: Q2/Q3 original eligibility differs; MRK/GE applicability unresolved.
Unsupported holdings opened before announcement still refuse; no backdating or repair.
Post-action standard root identity assumes Theta exact-symbol semantics.

owner_approval.scope: Exclude new positions crossing publicly announced unsupported spinoffs consistently across all methods; retain verified standard contracts. No new ADR/runtime code.

policy.scope: Q4 2021 entry candidate variant; retain FULL original chain and basis metadata. Q2/Q3 remain original eligibility.
policy.standard_identity_assumption: Theta honors its documented exact symbol/root request semantics; retained source provenance requests IBM/O with zero stitching, and exchange notices distinguish IBM1/O2 from resumed standard IBM/O. Independent per-row root/deliverable is not preserved in normalized files.
policy.earliest_rule_application: Next session after date-only announcement, before any affected weekly decision.
policy.filter_predicate: symbol matches AND quote_date >= usable_from AND quote_date < standard_resume AND expiry >= announced_distribution_date; remove paired forecast/context candidates only
policy.numeric_inputs: No prices, returns, weights or outcome values appear in the predicate.
policy.preserved: Every retained forecast/context numerical value and all original producer/training artifacts; full original chain, bars, sessions, all212names, methods and economics
policy.post_filter_serialization: Existing RecordsWrite emits canonical JSONL; lossless PyArrow serialization to original Parquet schema is transport only and does not decide eligibility.

rejected_quote_filter.reason: Removed metadata needed for supported IBM Oct29 expiry; candidate never launched

superseded_launch_review.finding: Missing settlement-day basis from filtering chain; full unchanged chain resolves at the preparation seam
